text.description_html:
Flush Mount Satin Nickel Door Pull, BAL-0397.056.SOL

This is a heavy duty contemporary design flush mount ring pull. The 3-1/2 inch square satin nickel over brass flush ring pulls is resistant to corrosion for marine use where flush installation is essential. Baldwin's Lifetime Satin Nickel finish is created by nickel-plating solid brass to highlight the beauty of the warm and smooth silver tone with the weight and quality of brass. This satin, matte-like PVD finish is extremely durable and is backed by Baldwin's Limited Lifetime Finish™ Warranty.

Specifications for the BAL-0397.056.SOL Satin Nickel Flush Ring Pull:

  • Total Height: 3-1/2" square
  • Door Cutout Diameter: 3"
  • Packaged with matching satin nickel plated brass mounting screws
